description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling recipe import functionality, including actions for initializing import, previewing, and submitting import data within a web application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Recipe::Import
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class managing recipe import workflows, including initialization, preview, and submission actions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Initializes the import process by loading the recipe and setting up the importer object.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Prepares and returns a preview of the recipe import, including candidate ingredients and recipe name adjustments.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles the submission of imported recipe data, validating and creating a new recipe, then redirecting to edit page.
